name: American Family Insurance (AmFam)
notes: Researched from public amfam.com payments pages and FAQ only (no sign-in). My Account > Billing & Payments: Make Payment (at least the minimum due, custom amount allowed, at most $10 over the account balance), Manage Scheduled Payments (cancel/reschedule; pending card transactions cannot change), Manage Payment Methods, Payment History (24 months), Statement History (24 months). Automatic payments draw from a debit/credit card or checking/savings on the date and amount chosen, with an email reminder; each billing account is set up separately. Separately, agent-managed Automated Funds Transfer (AFT) drafts checking/savings on the due date (next business day on weekends) and is stopped through the agent or 1-800-MYAMFAM 10 days before the next deduction. Pay Electronically accepts bank accounts and MasterCard, Visa, American Express, Discover. Due dates cannot be changed. Returned bank items incur a fee (amount not published). Pay by phone 1-866-424-8002. Life policies cannot be paid in My Account. Review 2026-10-09: the payments page offers Sign in to pay your bill and Pay as a guest; the public Pay Now form asks for billing number and ZIP code. Cancellation, login identifier and MFA are not documented publicly. Review 2026-10-10: guest form set to exactly billing number + ZIP (guestLookupExact), dropping the family's last-name field.

help.title: Pay your bill
paragraphs: In My Account, open Billing & Payments, pick the account from your Billing Accounts and choose Make Payment, then enter the payment method, date and amount.
Each payment must be at least the minimum amount due; you may enter a custom amount, but no more than $10 over the account balance. Payments usually apply within one business day (allow up to five).

You can also choose Pay as a guest on the website without My Account (have your billing account number and ZIP code ready), pay through a bank bill payer service, mail a payment, or call the automated Pay by Phone line at 1-866-424-8002.
Pay Electronically accepts personal and business checking or savings accounts and MasterCard, Visa, American Express and Discover cards.

help.title: Automatic payments
paragraphs: Automatic payments draw from a debit or credit card or a checking or savings account on a recurring basis. You choose the date, amount and method, and get an email reminder before each payment.

Each billing account needs its own automatic payment. To cancel or reschedule, go to Billing & Payments, select the account and open Manage Scheduled Payments; a pending card transaction cannot be changed.
steps: Open Billing & Payments and select the account.
Set up automatic payments or open Manage Scheduled Payments.

help.title: Automated Funds Transfer (AFT) through your agent
paragraphs: AFT, arranged through your agent or 1-800-MYAMFAM, deducts payments from checking or savings on the due date; if that falls on a weekend or holiday it runs the next business day, never earlier. It needs a signed authorization form.
When the amount changes you get a mailed statement marked as an automatic deduction that should not be paid.
To stop AFT, contact your agent or call 1-800-692-6326 at least 10 days before the next scheduled deduction.

help.title: Payment and statement history
paragraphs: Payment History in Billing & Payments shows successful, deleted and returned electronic payments from the past 24 months. Scheduled one-time and automatic payments are listed under Manage Scheduled Payments in Billing Overview.
Statements from the past 24 months are under Statement History; select the PDF icon to download or print one. Statements are also available in Spanish.

help.title: Due dates and returned payments
paragraphs: Your due date appears under the minimum amount due when you open an account in Billing & Payments. There is currently no option to change it.
If your bank does not honor a payment, a returned bank item fee is charged and you still must pay the minimum amount due by the due date to avoid a lapse.

extra.intent: Using American Family's Automated Funds Transfer (AFT) page, find how far in advance of the next deduction you must contact AmFam to stop AFT. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: At least 10 days before the next scheduled deduction.
